Design authority: docs/delivery/workspace-design.md, sections 5.3, 7.5, 11.3; court G. Visual references: mockups/workspace-vision-2026-09-22/README.md.
Repository owner: storyatlas4s. Delivery boundary: post-M1 / extended capability.
Integration parent: bd-01M1C2TVQTHW3KSESS9M0ET168; parent relationship does not itself block execution.
Entry dependencies: bd-01M35A7D5DH1AB8XYWH00DFFHE, bd-01M35A7B6R63M4B10R3J3XBW54.

REUSE, SCOPE AND PRESERVATION
Own profiling and only justified sparse/windowed app rendering. Reuse existing lowerings, Paginator and LatestIntent; separate decode/provider compilation/pagination/lowering/DOM/layout cost. Keep full recomputation as equivalence oracle; do not introduce a speculative renderer or dense cohort tensor.

ACCEPTANCE AND FAILURE WITNESSES
1. Use versioned 524-unit/1000-target/15000-link and 100000-word fixtures with named machine/browser/DPR and cold/warm conditions.
2. After measured changes, focus/selection/text copying and exact values survive recycling, offscreen alternatives, last row/target, resize and tighter horizons.
3. Cache/request keys include actual artifact/capability/result/cut/selection dependencies; obsolete completion cannot activate; display cost tracks visible ranges.

EVIDENCE
Record exact producer/consumer/dependency revisions, fixture digests, actual commands/results and warnings/skips. Apply design section 11.5 and AGENTS.md to the changed runtime boundary, including compileAll testAll scalafmtCheckAll app/fastLinkJS and relevant existing/new browser courts for shell changes; use isolated siblings and session-owned project browsers. Documentation-only or human-study evidence is scoped as such. New test names are specifications until implemented and run. No inference, calibration, hosted CI, publication or release is certified by ticket creation.

FALLBACK
Retain uncached exact compilation and paged table; report missed budgets rather than deleting hard cases.

Coordinate one implementation writer and one heavy build at a time. Reserve exact paths when taking the ticket; do not claim other writers' scopes. Keep scientific operations in StoryModel, reuse this application and preserve unrelated edits.
set.title: [Scale] Measure and implement bounded sparse rendering without identity loss
